G6P and pyruvate are major junctions. Glycolysis is cytosolic; PDH/TCA are matrix processes. Fatty-acid synthesis is cytosolic and receives acetyl units through citrate export—not from the inner mitochondrial membrane.

Use the disease atlas to connect a molecular lesion to pathway flux, accumulated substrates, depleted products, compensatory pathways, labs, and clinical phenotype. The registry below was expanded after auditing the metabolism-focused Week 4 materials.

🏃 Run Forrest Run

In Forrest Gump, Forrest starts his iconic cross-country journey for no particular reason, simply explaining that he “just felt like running.” Forrest spontaneously begins running and ultimately spends 3 years, 2 months, 14 days, and 16 hours running repeatedly across the United States. Forrest turns an impulsive run into repeated coast-to-coast running; this teaching timeline uses that fictional endurance journey to ask how fuel selection would change from a short run to hours and days of running, especially if carbohydrate intake becomes limited.

Sprint
ATP demand

Energy-stress signaling (AMPK)

Muscle contraction promotes GLUT4 translocation independently of insulin. Epinephrine supports muscle glycogenolysis; glucagon primarily targets liver rather than skeletal muscle.
